n93e2d8d4bb.headline: SDS unit acquires factories, production lines for RM28mil
n93e2d8d4bb.summary: SDS Top Baker Sdn Bhd, an indirect subsidiary of SDS Group Bhd, agreed to acquire seven land parcels with factories in Plentong, Johor Bahru, and their production lines from Mamee Bakery for RM28 million.
n93e2d8d4bb.why: SDS Group is a Malaysian listed company, and acquisitions of production assets affect its manufacturing capacity and earnings base.

nb08579d5fb.headline: Bulgaria records 5.3% annual inflation in July
nb08579d5fb.summary: Bulgaria's annual consumer price inflation reached 5.3% in July, up from 4.4% a month earlier, the National Statistical Institute said on August 15.
nb08579d5fb.why: Consumer price inflation drives central bank policy and real returns on Bulgarian assets and debt.

nf03482c0f5.headline: Nigerian stocks rangebound as market awaits July inflation figures
nf03482c0f5.summary: Nigerian stocks traded in a narrow range as the market awaited July inflation figures. The report did not give index levels.
nf03482c0f5.why: The Nigerian Exchange is the main venue for Nigerian equities, and inflation data influences local rate expectations and equity valuations.

n1ca5448daf.headline: Russia and Iran Engage in Talks Over Rasht-Astara Railway Project
n1ca5448daf.summary: Russian Prime Minister Mikhail Mishustin and Iranian First Vice President Mohammad Reza Aref discussed the Rasht-Astara railway project in Cholpon-Ata, Kyrgyzstan. The talks covered the project's terms.
n1ca5448daf.why: The Rasht-Astara railway is planned to link Iran's rail network with Russia and form part of the International North-South Transport Corridor. Such projects can shift freight routes and trade costs.

n63df1594d4.headline: Should You Buy Berkshire Hathaway Stock, Even Though It's Down 10% Since Warren Buffett Announced He's Retiring as CEO?
n63df1594d4.summary: Berkshire Hathaway stock has fallen about 10% since Warren Buffett announced his retirement as chief executive. The article questions whether the drop was warranted.
n63df1594d4.why: Berkshire Hathaway is a large conglomerate led for decades by Warren Buffett, whose capital allocation strategy is closely watched by investors.

impacts.name: Berkshire Hathaway
impacts.why: Shares fell after the CEO retirement announcement, per the article.

n6313e3149a.headline: US Treasury’s Scott Bessent Says Strategic Bitcoin Reserve Will Rely on Budget-Neutral Acquisitions
n6313e3149a.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the Strategic Bitcoin Reserve will rely on budget-neutral acquisitions, reversing earlier remarks on the plan.
n6313e3149a.why: Bitcoin is the largest cryptocurrency, and government holdings or purchases can affect its demand and market sentiment.

n5181855f9f.headline: EGENCO struggles with power generation amid Faulty machines, load shedding to continue
n5181855f9f.summary: Malawi's power generator EGENCO is struggling to generate power because of faulty machines, and load shedding will continue.
n5181855f9f.why: Power shortages constrain industrial output and business operations in the affected economy.

n5484e2aacf.headline: 146 Nigerian Women To Share $50m WTO Digital Trade Grants
n5484e2aacf.summary: The WTO launched the first phase of its Women Exporters in Digital Economy Fund in Nigeria, targeting $50 million of investment, with 146 women set to share grants.
n5484e2aacf.why: The WTO is the global body governing trade rules, and this fund supports women-led exporters in digital trade.

n12a86712bf.headline: Nigerian stock market momentum fades as subdued oil prices and revenue weigh on sentiment
n12a86712bf.summary: Momentum in the Nigerian stock market has faded as subdued oil prices and revenue weigh on sentiment. The report describes weaker investor confidence in the market.
n12a86712bf.why: Nigeria's economy and government revenues depend heavily on oil, so oil price movements feed into local equity sentiment.

n0283645cc5.headline: Inheritance tax squeeze is coming as deVere warn Reeves’ plans could widen the net
n0283645cc5.summary: Financial adviser deVere warns that Chancellor Rachel Reeves' plans could widen the inheritance tax net. The warning concerns the scope of the proposed changes.
n0283645cc5.why: Inheritance tax changes affect estate planning and wealth transfers, which matter for private wealth managers and the UK tax base.

nd374196f18.headline: Toxic Spill at China-Owned Zambian Mine 30 Times Worse Than Estimated
nd374196f18.summary: A partial collapse of a waste dam at a Chinese state-owned copper mine in Zambia may have released 30 times more toxic sludge than estimated. The spill is reported by Insurance Journal.
nd374196f18.why: Copper miners face environmental liabilities and operational disruption from tailings failures, which can affect output and costs.

nb91fc88750.headline: CBK accepts Ksh. 21.77B in treasury bill sale as investor demand rises
nb91fc88750.summary: The Central Bank of Kenya accepted KSh 21.77 billion in bids as investor demand rose, split between KSh 14.12 billion in competitive and KSh 7.65 billion in non-competitive bids.
nb91fc88750.why: The Central Bank of Kenya runs government securities auctions that set domestic short-term borrowing costs and influence local yields.

ncd5b6ae2bd.headline: Ghana's Economy Shows Resilience - World Bank Report
ncd5b6ae2bd.summary: A World Bank report says Ghana's economy is showing resilience, with growth of 5.7% in 2024 and 5.3% in the first quarter of 2025. The report is cited by DailyGuide Network.
ncd5b6ae2bd.why: The World Bank is a multilateral lender whose country assessments inform investor views on sovereign risk and growth in emerging markets.

n3e7742f9d9.headline: BoG sees room for further monetary policy rate easing - Governor
n3e7742f9d9.summary: The Bank of Ghana said there is scope for further monetary policy easing if macroeconomic conditions continue to improve. It added that this could broaden access to credit and support private sector-led growth.
n3e7742f9d9.why: Central bank policy rates shape borrowing costs, bank lending and currency expectations. Ghana's policy path is closely followed by investors in its bonds and banking sector.

n5eceb0dd2c.headline: What’s at Stake in the Alaska Summit
n5eceb0dd2c.summary: US President Donald Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin are meeting in Alaska to initiate a potential ceasefire and eventual end to Russia's war in Ukraine.
n5eceb0dd2c.why: Geopolitical talks between Washington and Moscow shape sanctions, energy flows and risk sentiment across European and global markets.

nd4bb8350ae.headline: Toyota to enter SA
nd4bb8350ae.summary: Toyota currently sells only hybrid electric vehicles in South Africa but holds a 67% share of the hybrid and plug-in hybrid market, according to the report.
nd4bb8350ae.why: Toyota is a major global automaker, and its share of hybrid sales in key markets shapes the competitive landscape for electrified vehicles.

n477a2688d4.headline: Pension funds: Strike countdown begins as PenCom, Labour disagree
n477a2688d4.summary: The Nigeria Labour Congress has issued a seven-day strike notice over an alleged 40% diversion of pension funds. PenCom has reacted, while NSITF has not commented.
n477a2688d4.why: Pension funds are large domestic investors in Nigerian government debt and equities. Disputes over pension assets can affect capital markets and regulatory confidence.

n0dfe0fdbbb.headline: Is UnitedHealth Group a Buy After Warren Buffett Enters the Picture?
n0dfe0fdbbb.summary: Warren Buffett has taken a $1.6 billion stake in UnitedHealth Group. The move sent the healthcare giant's shares up 9% after hours.
n0dfe0fdbbb.why: UnitedHealth is the largest US health insurer and operator of the Optum healthcare services business. Stakes by Berkshire Hathaway, Buffett's conglomerate, are closely watched by investors.

impacts.name: UnitedHealth Group
impacts.why: Shares rose about 9% after hours following the reported stake.

n0dfe0fdbbb.why_moved: A $1.6 billion stake from Warren Buffett is a high-profile vote of confidence in a company whose shares had been battered. The report says shares rose 9% after hours.

nf8dcab509c.headline: China Maintained Strong Oil Refining Output in July
nf8dcab509c.summary: China's oil refining output remained strong in July. State-owned refiners increased utilization, and crude oil imports jumped.
nf8dcab509c.why: China is the world's largest crude oil importer and refiner, so its refining runs and import volumes influence global oil demand. Investors track these figures as a gauge of Asian energy consumption.

n66218219bd.headline: Lidl to increase hourly staff pay for fifth time in two years
n66218219bd.summary: Lidl will increase hourly pay for its staff in the UK, the fifth such rise in two years. The increase will take effect in September.
n66218219bd.why: Lidl is a German discount supermarket chain with a large UK operation, and wage rises affect its cost base in a competitive grocery market.

nc2c5976a83.headline: Nigeria's headline inflation nosedives to 21.88% in July
nc2c5976a83.summary: Nigeria's headline inflation fell to 21.88% in July, according to the National Bureau of Statistics. Year-on-year food inflation edged up while core inflation declined.
nc2c5976a83.why: Inflation data guides the Central Bank of Nigeria's rate decisions and the naira's outlook.

n0d051ba3f4.headline: E-invoicing: Nigerian payment gateways to report all transactions to FIRS for compliance monitoring
n0d051ba3f4.summary: The Federal Inland Revenue Service has mandated payment gateways to report all transactions passing through their systems for tax compliance monitoring, as e-invoicing rolls out for major businesses.
n0d051ba3f4.why: The FIRS is Nigeria's federal tax authority, and transaction reporting rules affect payment providers, merchants and tax collection in Africa's largest economy.

n18cf984b12.headline: Slumping factory output, retail sales deliver blow to Chinese economy
n18cf984b12.summary: China's factory output growth fell to its weakest pace in eight months in July, while retail sales slowed markedly, adding pressure on policymakers.
n18cf984b12.why: China is the world's second-largest economy and a major driver of global commodity demand and manufacturing supply chains.

ne1a4b3962c.headline: New Zealand's population exodus hits 13-year high as economy worsens
ne1a4b3962c.summary: New Zealand citizens leaving the country reached the highest level in 13 years, with over a third of emigrants aged under 30. Unemployment is rising and economic growth remains soft.
ne1a4b3962c.why: Emigration of young workers reduces the labour supply and tax base, which weighs on long-term growth and the fiscal outlook.

n2479317841.headline: Ringgit ends higher on continued US$ weakness
n2479317841.summary: The ringgit closed the week stronger against the US dollar as the greenback stayed weak. Higher-than-expected US producer prices for July did not provide lasting dollar support.
n2479317841.why: The ringgit is Malaysia's currency, and its moves against the dollar affect import costs, investment flows and regional currency sentiment.

n402e0c5313.headline: Business conditions relatively flat
n402e0c5313.summary: Business performance in Port Moresby, especially in retail, was relatively flat in the first and second quarters, according to the chamber of commerce president.
n402e0c5313.why: Retail activity in the capital is a gauge of domestic consumer demand and economic momentum in Papua New Guinea.

n7ce10fa9cd.headline: Applied Materials' shares sink on weak China demand, tariff risks
n7ce10fa9cd.summary: Applied Materials shares fell nearly 14% in premarket trading after weak fourth-quarter forecasts citing sluggish China demand. Similar tariff warnings came from ASML.
n7ce10fa9cd.why: Applied Materials makes chip-manufacturing equipment, so its orders track global semiconductor capital spending. China is a major market for chip-equipment makers, and export and tariff risks affect them directly.

impacts.name: Applied Materials
impacts.why: Shares fell after the company issued weak fourth-quarter forecasts on China demand and tariff risks.

n7ce10fa9cd.why_moved: The company's weak fourth-quarter forecast, tied to sluggish China demand and tariff-related risks, drove the premarket sell-off.

n579d4417a4.headline: Inside SA’s multi-million rand plan to fill US funding void
n579d4417a4.summary: US grants worth more than R1bn a year to South Africa's health system have been pulled. Treasury, the Gates Foundation and the Wellcome Trust are filling some of the gaps.
n579d4417a4.why: Donor funding supports public health programmes and research in South Africa, so cuts shift the cost burden onto domestic budgets and other funders.

nbf03a2d257.headline: Narai Hotel to Join The Unbound Collection by Hyatt in Thailand
nbf03a2d257.summary: A Hyatt affiliate has entered into management agreements with Narai Hotel Company Limited, and the hotel will join The Unbound Collection by Hyatt.
nbf03a2d257.why: Hyatt Hotels Corporation is a global hotel operator, and management deals expand its brand portfolio without requiring it to own the property.

nddc2a4706c.headline: PSX gains on earnings and economic optimism
nddc2a4706c.summary: The Pakistan Stock Exchange rose on Friday on strong corporate earnings, active mutual fund participation and economic optimism. The KSE-100 hit an intraday high of 147,534.41 points before easing to 146,894.62, down 0.02%.
nddc2a4706c.why: The Pakistan Stock Exchange is the country's main equity market, and the KSE-100 is its benchmark index of the largest listed companies. Its moves reflect domestic investor sentiment and corporate earnings.
nddc2a4706c.why_moved: Strong corporate earnings, mutual fund participation and optimism about economic improvement lifted sentiment, though the index gave back most of its intraday gains by the close.

n640f903ad3.headline: Pandora Reports Expected Drop in Operating Profit for Q2
n640f903ad3.summary: Danish jewellery maker Pandora reported second-quarter results largely in line with analyst expectations. Revenue met forecasts and rose 4.5%, while operating profit matched projections, though the headline notes an expected profit drop.
n640f903ad3.why: Pandora is a Copenhagen-listed jewellery brand sold through its own stores and wholesale partners, and its quarterly results are closely watched by consumer and luxury investors.

impacts.name: Pandora
impacts.why: Quarterly results in line with forecasts give investors a reference for the company's current trading.

nd282e22a75.headline: HMM cancels W2tr in shares to lift stock value
nd282e22a75.summary: HMM, South Korea's largest container shipping company, plans to buy 2.14 trillion won ($1.54 billion) of its own shares by September. The buyback is part of its effort to lift its stock value.
nd282e22a75.why: HMM is a major container shipping line, and its share buybacks reflect its capital allocation amid the cyclical global shipping market.

ncf03af76cd.headline: Bitcoin retreats from record peak on US inflation fears
ncf03af76cd.summary: Bitcoin fell on Friday after touching a new record high the previous day, weighed down by hotter-than-expected US inflation data.
ncf03af76cd.why: Bitcoin is the largest cryptocurrency by market value, and its price is often sensitive to US interest-rate expectations.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Bitcoin pulled back from its record after the US inflation report came in hotter than expected.

n7effd272da.headline: Robust domestic demand drives 4.4% GDP growth in 2Q
n7effd272da.summary: Malaysia's economy grew 4.4% year on year in the second quarter of 2025, slightly below the official estimate, Bank Negara said, with robust domestic demand a key driver.
n7effd272da.why: Quarterly GDP growth is a key indicator for policymakers and investors assessing Malaysia's economic momentum and interest-rate outlook.

n855517e875.headline: Dow hits hits all-time high after steady US retail sales data
n855517e875.summary: The Dow Jones hit an all-time high after US retail sales rose 0.5% in July, meeting forecasts. Sales excluding cars rose 0.3%, also in line with estimates.
n855517e875.why: The Dow Jones Industrial Average tracks 30 large US blue-chip companies, and retail sales data is a key gauge of US consumer spending.
n855517e875.why_moved: Retail sales matched forecasts, supporting confidence in consumer spending and pushing the Dow to a record.

nd55acb53b3.headline: Fossil fuel jobs fail to keep pace with production and profits, report finds
nd55acb53b3.summary: A new report finds Canadian oil and gas production is up 47% since 2012 while jobs are down 17%, driven by automation and a shift to short-term profits.
nd55acb53b3.why: Oil and gas is a major Canadian export sector, and productivity and automation trends affect costs, output and regional employment.

nfc14a88a8b.headline: Dow opens in record territory as Wall Street gets rate-cut fever
nfc14a88a8b.summary: The Dow was on pace to close at its first record high of the year on Friday, reflecting steady optimism on Wall Street, though underlying turbulence was noted.
nfc14a88a8b.why: The Dow Jones Industrial Average tracks 30 large US blue-chip companies and is a widely followed gauge of US equity market sentiment.
nfc14a88a8b.why_moved: Optimism over expected interest rate cuts lifted the index toward a record high, according to the report.

n9858b2f6ab.headline: Rogers to sell nine data centers to InfraRed Capital
n9858b2f6ab.summary: Rogers Communications will sell nine data centers to InfraRed Capital. Rogers will continue to sell data center services on behalf of InfraRed and provide network connectivity to the sites.
n9858b2f6ab.why: Rogers is a major Canadian telecom operator, and asset sales of this kind shift capital from infrastructure ownership toward service revenue.

n1dcbd809aa.headline: Beyond the chipmakers: 3 ‘hidden’ stocks powering India’s semiconductor boom
n1dcbd809aa.summary: India’s semiconductor sector is projected to hit ₹8.9 lakh crore by 2030, with companies like Kaynes, CG Power, and VA Tech Wabag gaining prominence post-Micron deal.
n1dcbd809aa.why: The semiconductor industry is critical for technology supply chains and economic growth, with India aiming to become a key player in this global sector.

n0de2346a49.headline: Food Price Index Rises in July on Higher Meat and Vegetable Oil Prices
n0de2346a49.summary: The FAO Food Price Index averaged 130.1 points in July 2025, up 2.1 points or 1.6 percent. The rise was driven by higher meat and vegetable oil prices.
n0de2346a49.why: The FAO index tracks monthly changes in international food commodity prices, a key gauge of global food inflation and agricultural trade conditions.

n4ec01d3b3c.summary: The Central Bank of Azerbaijan said it completed trial periods in the first stage of a special regulatory regime. Binance commented on the country's potential in crypto and blockchain.
n4ec01d3b3c.why: Central bank crypto frameworks determine whether digital asset firms can operate legally in a market, affecting exchange access and investor participation.

ndb7b3686fc.summary: China has launched interest subsidy policies on loans intended to stimulate consumption. The official said policies to expand consumption will remain in effect.
ndb7b3686fc.why: Consumption support measures influence demand for Chinese retailers, autos and banks and the outlook for China's economic recovery.

n11bef98eb3.summary: President Luis Abinader inaugurated the Baní bypass in Peravia Province, a project meant to reduce travel time and speed traffic. The road is expected to boost development in the Southern provinces.
n11bef98eb3.why: Transport infrastructure lowers logistics costs and can support investment in regional economies.

n5e7640e1f7.summary: A cement crisis in Bamako has pushed up prices and paralysed the construction sector, according to Mali Actu.
n5e7640e1f7.why: Cement is a core input for construction, so price spikes in building materials affect project costs and activity across the economy.

n30ed95853a.headline: Morocco prepares for a pension reform by 2030
n30ed95853a.summary: Morocco is preparing a pension reform by 2030 to guarantee the sustainability of its pension schemes, as its financial reserves face imminent depletion.
n30ed95853a.why: Pension system funding affects public finances and long-term government borrowing needs.
